name: companion
description: Telegram channel for Ship Shape: a bot that bridges your Telegram DMs to one Claude Code session, with pairing and an allowlist. Polls only in the session launched with --channels plugin:companion@shipshape (or the development flag), and stays inert everywhere else. Manage access with /companion:access and setup with /companion:configure. Adapted from the official Telegram channel plugin (Apache-2.0).
